metadata.question: Did vegetation cover increase in Warburton Creek between June 20, 2025 and September 15, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Location: Warburton Creek, Australia → I'll use a small buffer around the creek channel near Warburton township (-26.13°, 133.35°). 2. Collection: Sentinel-2 for its 10 m resolution and short revisit time. 3. Dates: 20 Jun – 15 Sep 2025. 4. Logic: Compute NDVI per date-window (±7 days) and compare the mean NDVI of the two windows. 5. Masking: Sentinel-2 CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE < 20 % and use QA60 cloud-mask. 6. Check: If either window has 0 images or 0 valid pixels → C1 or C2. 7. Final: If NDVI change > 0, A; else B; if None/NaN etc. → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') pt = ee.Geometry.Point([133.35, -26.13]).buffer(2000) # 2 km buffer around Warburton Creek start1, end1 = '2025-06-13', '2025-06-27' start2, end2 = '2025-09-08', '2025-09-22' def s2_ndvi(d1, d2): col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(pt) .filterDate(d1, d2) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)) .map(lambda img: img.select(['B4', 'B8']) .normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']) .rename('NDVI') .updateMask(img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).And(img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1 << 11))).Not() .updateMask(img.select('NDVI').gte(-1).And(img.select('NDVI').lte(1))))) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: return None, n mean = col.mean().multiply(10000).int16() # boost precision cnt = mean.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=pt, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() if cnt == 0: return None, n val = mean.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=pt, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() return val/10000.0, n v1, s1 = s2_ndvi(start1, end1) print(f"Jun 2025 NDVI: {v1}, Images: {s1}") if v1 is None or s1 == 0: print("C1") v2, s2 = s2_ndvi(start2, end2) print(f"Sep 2025 NDVI: {v2}, Images: {s2}") if v2 is None or s2 == 0: print("C1") if v1 is None or v2 is None: print("C3") elif v2 > v1: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

pt = ee.Geometry.Point([133.35, -26.13]).buffer(2000)  # 2 km buffer around Warburton Creek
start1, end1 = '2025-06-13', '2025-06-27'
start2, end2 = '2025-09-08', '2025-09-22'

def s2_ndvi(d1, d2):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
             .filterBounds(pt)
             .filterDate(d1, d2)
             .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20))
             .map(lambda img: img.select(['B4', 'B8'])
                  .normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4'])
                  .rename('NDVI')
                  .updateMask(img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).And(img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1 << 11))).Not()
                  .updateMask(img.select('NDVI').gte(-1).And(img.select('NDVI').lte(1)))))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0: return None, n
    mean = col.mean().multiply(10000).int16()  # boost precision
    cnt = mean.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=pt, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
    if cnt == 0: return None, n
    val = mean.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=pt, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
    return val/10000.0, n

v1, s1 = s2_ndvi(start1, end1)
print(f"Jun 2025 NDVI: {v1}, Images: {s1}")
if v1 is None or s1 == 0: print("<answer>C1</answer>")
v2, s2 = s2_ndvi(start2, end2)
print(f"Sep 2025 NDVI: {v2}, Images: {s2}")
if v2 is None or s2 == 0: print("<answer>C1</answer>")

if v1 is None or v2 is None: print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif v2 > v1: print("<answer>A</answer>")
else: print("<answer>B</answer>")
